status: Implemented; focused parser/location/ownership tests and both host builds pass. Real URL delivery, warm/cold launch and latest full-core acceptance are pending.

protocol.canonical: snowfolio://open?url=<encoded absolute file URL>&line=<one-based line>&column=<one-based UTF16 column>
protocol.compatibility: Explicitly app-targeted x-macdown links are parsed; their existing system URL handler is not registered or changed.
protocol.validation: Known target/line/column query items must be unique. Local absolute file URLs only; remote hosts, credentials, ports, fragments, file queries and decoded null bytes are rejected. Optional location defaults column to1 when a line exists; a column requires a line. Unknown optional query items remain ignored like the original.
protocol.navigation: Foundation line boundaries and UTF16 columns clamp at content ends and composed-character boundaries, including CRLF, non-BMP emoji and combining marks. Computation runs off the UI actor. A newer source revision prevents stale positioning.
protocol.opening: Normal NSDocumentController open with display, reusing existing documents. No alternate reader/writer/autosave/Undo policy, no file creation for URL links and no evaluation of input as a command.
protocol.ownership: Native documents expose their shared model directly. The regular host resolves its model via a weak, event-driven window registration and public NSDocument ownership. Cancellation releases waiters/deadlines; a failed8-second lookup reports an error without changing source.
protocol.view: Location requests reveal the source from preview-only mode. Hidden source views defer selection until visible and existing marked-text protection remains.
protocol.lifecycle: Get-URL handler installed during will/did-finish launch for both hosts; ordered queue retains requests across asynchronous opening.
